```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run Claude for issue triage
        id: claude
        uses: anthropic/claude@v1
        with:
          model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620
          prompt: |
            You are an issue triage assistant for the OB1 repository. The issue has the following details:
            Title: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
            Body: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
            Your task:
            1. Classify the issue into one of the following categories: bug, recipe idea, schema idea, feature request, documentation, duplicate, or other.
            2. Check if the issue is a duplicate of an existing open issue. If so, provide the duplicate issue number.
            3. Assess if the issue scope fits the OB1 contribution guidelines. If it does not, suggest a better place or ask for clarification.
            4. Suggest appropriate labels to apply to the issue.
            5. Draft a welcoming comment that thanks the contributor, explains the triage result, and provides next steps.
            Output in JSON format with keys: category, duplicate_issue, scope_fit, suggested_labels, comment.
          max_tokens: 800
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Capture Claude output
        id: parse
        run: echo "claude_json=${{ steps.claude.outputs.output }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Apply suggested labels
        if: steps.parse.outputs.claude_json != ''
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          CLAUDE_JSON: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.claude_json }}
        with:
          script: |
            const output = JSON.parse(process.env.CLAUDE_JSON);
            if (output.suggested_labels && output.suggested_labels.length > 0) {
              await github.issues.addLabels({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: context.issue.number,
                labels: output.suggested_labels
              });
            }

      - name: Post welcoming comment
        if: steps.parse.outputs.claude_json != ''
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          CLAUDE_JSON: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.claude_json }}
        with:
          script: |
            const output = JSON.parse(process.env.CLAUDE_JSON);
            if (output.comment) {
              await github.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: context.issue.number,
                body: output.comment
              });
            }
```
